add.name: competitors
add.purpose: Builds competitor comparison and alternative pages ('X vs Y', 'X alternatives') for SEO and buyers, in four formats, plus an audit mode for stale comparison pages.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'alternative page', 'vs page', 'competitor comparison'. Optional product-marketing context file.
add.evidence: skills.sh ~68k installs; 52k-star repo (also mirrored in seomachine and aitmpl as 'competitor-alternatives')

add.name: directory-submissions
add.purpose: Plans and tracks submissions to startup/SaaS/AI/MCP and review directories for backlinks, domain rating and discovery, with a prioritised directory tracker.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'directory submissions', 'backlinks from directories', 'submit to Product Hunt/G2/AlternativeTo'.

add.name: content-writer
add.purpose: SEO content writing in two modes: new drafts (keywords, headers, featured-snippet targets, evidence boundaries) and refresh of decaying pages with prioritised update work.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'write SEO content', 'draft a blog post/landing page', 'fix ranking decay'.
add.evidence: Same author/repo as listed keyword-research; the mirror aaron-he-zhu/seo-geo-claude-skills 'seo-content-writer' has ~7.6k skills.sh installs

add.name: apify-ai-search-visibility-tracker
add.purpose: Tracks whether a brand and its competitors are cited across Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Copilot and Gemini for a prompt set, on a recurring schedule.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'track AI visibility', 'GEO tracking', 'ChatGPT citations'. Needs APIFY_TOKEN (paid Actor runs).
add.evidence: Official Apify vendor skill; listed on mcpservers.org
add.notes: Measurement side of GEO; the list's GEO skills are optimisation-only. Paid usage.
